subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive & architecture playbook
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Chen <daniel.chen@hightide.ai>, Samira Patel <samira@hightide.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive & architecture playbook

Hi Daniel / Samira —

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday — great context on your throughput goals and the regulatory constraints around data residency. Ben and I discussed internally and we think the right next step is a focused technical deep-dive (60–90 minutes) to: 

- validate topology and network requirements for VPC/private deployment
- walk through recommended inference topology (caching, batching, fallback models) for your peak workload
- align on rollout strategy and ops responsibilities (SRE handover, runbook)

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed Apr 22, 10:00–11:30 (best for our infra engineers)
- Thu Apr 23, 14:00–15:30 (backup)

If neither works, share a couple slots that do — we can be flexible on duration. I’ll include Ben (runtime lead) and can pull Rishi (security) if you want a short segment on compliance.

Suggested agenda (we can tailor):
1) 10m — goals + success criteria
2) 25m — proposed topology and kernel/quantization profile choices
3) 20m — network/firewall/KMS and data flow considerations
4) 15m — runbook & rollout + Q&A

No attachments yet; I can drop a lightweight agenda and the network checklist once we lock time.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0126

From: Daniel Chen <daniel.chen@hightide.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira@hightide.ai>, procurement@hightide.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive & architecture playbook

Priyom — thanks, this looks good. A couple of notes from our side: 

- Can you include someone from security for the KMS/SOC2 discussion? I want to make sure we cover key rotation and audit logging. Rishi from Redwood was great on the discovery, can he join?
- Procurement is requesting we try to accelerate next steps; they're free Wed Apr 21 11:00–12:00 PT (earlier than your windows). If you have a short 45–60m option that would be ideal for our execs.

If we do the longer deep-dive with Ben and Rishi, that's still valuable — I'm just trying to get procurement a brief alignment first so they know the contract path.

Thanks — Daniel
Director, Platform Engineering | HighTide Analytics
daniel.chen@hightide.ai | (206) 555-7182

Daniel — thanks for the note. I added Rishi to the thread; he can cover SOC2/KMS and audit log expectations.

We can do a short procurement alignment and a longer architecture session. To accommodate both calendars, propose: 

- Thu Apr 22, 10:30–11:30 PT — combined deep-dive (60m) with a 15–20m procurement segment at the start.

That lets us keep the longer technical conversation while giving procurement a concise window. I cleared Ben for that slot; Rishi confirmed availability for 10:45–11:30 if you want him for the deeper security piece.

I’m dropping a lightweight agenda and two attachments for pre-read: redwood-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (agenda + roles), network-requirements.xlsx (high-level checklist). Also a short runbook draft (prelim-runbook.md) for context. Calendar invite will follow from my calendar.

Calendly (if you'd prefer to pick another slot): https://cal.com/redwood/priyom-30
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/HT-2026-0420

Attaching: redwood-deep-dive-agenda.pdf, network-requirements.xlsx, prelim-runbook.md

Thanks — Thu Apr 22, 10:30–11:30 PT works for us. Calendar invite accepted; I've added procurement and our cloud networking lead so they can join the 10:30–10:50 segment.

Request: please make sure the network checklist covers our managed firewall (Palo Alto) and the proxy egress rules — procurement will need those items to validate the connection diagram. Also, we'll ask for SOC2 artifact pointers after the call (no need to send now).

Looking forward to the session.

— Samira
